svg.text: Rail hazmat releases, conterminous U.S., 2016-2025: 146 incidents
Hazmat released, by severity:
deaths (any cause)

evacuation
release only
Gi* hot cell, 99%
Gi* hot cell, 95%
any Form 54 accident
Gi* hot cells: 10 at 99%, 34 at 95%. By severity: 2 persons killed (any cause); 13 persons injured (any cause); 18
persons evacuated; 113 release, none of the above reported. The box is the Mid-Atlantic figure's region.
Data: FRA Form 6180.54 rail equipment accidents, row fra-form54-rail-equipment-accidents (sha256 a18b348a2dc1),
2016-2025: one point per incident with any car releasing hazmat (Block 10), at its reported coordinates (Blocks
50-51). PHMSA's 5800.1 incident reports are not held (row phmsa-hazmat-incident-reports; Issue ff08a05d), so highway,
air and water releases are not on this map.
Method: Getis-Ord Gi*, rows getis-ord-1992-distance-statistics (DOI 10.1111/j.1538-4632.1992.tb00261.x),
ord-getis-1995-local-spatial-autocorrelation (DOI 10.1111/j.1538-4632.1995.tb00912.x), not held and cited by row and
DOI; 71 km equal-area hexagons (Albers, EPSG:5070 parameters), each cell with its six neighbours, over the 1,258
cells with any Form 54 accident; one-sided p by 9,999 seeded permutations; no cell survives a Benjamini-Hochberg
false discovery rate of 0.05, so the hot cells are exploratory.
Severity: the report's own fields, the highest that applies; killed and injured are Form 55a's per-accident totals,
from any cause.
